v2.1.0 Update
Requires GlitchSmith Library 0.13.2 or later.
- Dark Fantasy turns the Character shop into an iron noticeboard. Cursed Curios has a cabinet of antique drawers in both Character and Grid layouts.
- Give an unidentified item a display name, image and description. After purchase, the buyer sees its real name and configured stats on a private screen that matches the shop's theme.
- Shopkeepers can use looping WEBM or MP4 portraits. Greetings, farewells and other effects can choose from several sound files.
- Set which item types a shop buys, search for icons, or open shops in a window by default.
- Display Stats supports formulas. Project FU weapons show their accuracy and damage automatically.
- Large catalogs save faster. Duplicate listings keep their own prices and stock, and another player's purchase keeps your confirmation open.

announcement.title: 🛍️ Stylish Shop v2.1.0
announcement.content:
Update GlitchSmith Library to 0.13.2 or later before updating Stylish Shop. It fixes character sheet payments getting stuck when another GM takes over.

Choose either new storefront in Shop Settings under Appearance. Unidentified items work in every shop theme.

  • Dark Fantasy displays categories and wares on iron plates against a ruined abbey. Cursed Curios displays each antique's history and writes purchases on a pawn ticket. Choose Character or Grid for the antique shop.
  • In Products & stock, expand an item and turn on List as an unidentified item. Set the name, image and description players see while browsing. When the buyer receives the item, a private screen in the shop's theme shows its real name, artwork, description and the stats set for its type. Public purchase messages use the display name.
  • Use a looping video for the shopkeeper. Enter one sound file per line to vary the greeting, farewell or other shop effects.
  • Choose which item types a merchant buys. World rules apply until a shop sets its own.
  • Combine item fields in a display stat or use the built-in Project FU weapon formulas. A new icon picker searches English names and common Korean terms.
  • Large shops save faster. Open shops show price and stock edits made in the Smartphone Shop App. Editing a quantity keeps that row in view in the sell cart.
